candidate_relations.reason: Although Peutz-Jeghers syndrome can cause gastrointestinal polyps and pigmentation, the diffuse gastric and colorectal polyposis with hypoproteinemia, onychodystrophy, and acquired ectodermal changes supports the benchmark diagnosis of Cronkhite-Canada syndrome.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct hereditary hamartomatous polyposis syndrome rather than Cronkhite-Canada syndrome.
